1. Business Bronze Rewards Card: Making Payments and Managing Your Balance
   ID: doc_business_credit_cards_business_bronze_rewards_card_007
   Score: 27.7708
   Content: ## Interest on Carried Balances
- If you do not pay your statement balance in full by the due date, interest accrues at a variable rate of 20.49%.

## Payment Methods and Scheduling
- Set up recurring payments to automatically pay either your statement balance or a chosen fixed amount each cycle.
- You can also make one-time payments from your linked bank account at any time.

## Avoiding Fees and Managing Cash Flow
- Pay at least your minimum due by the due date on your statement to avoid a late fee of $32.50.
- Consider paying more frequently to reduce average daily balance and interest charges when carrying a balance at 20.49%.
- Monitor pending transactions and authorizations so you know what will post before your payment clears.

## If a Payment Is Late
- A late payment fee of $32.50 may be assessed, and interest continues to accrue at 20.49% on unpaid balances.
- Make the past‑due payment as soon as possible to minimize additional interest.

2. EcoCard: Making Payments and Managing Your Account
   ID: doc_credit_cards_ecocard_008
   Score: 23.9325
   Content: ## Minimum Payment and Due Date
- Your minimum monthly payment is 1.0% of your outstanding balance (plus any past due amounts and fees as applicable).
- Pay by the due date to avoid a late payment fee of $32.50.

## Interest and Fees to Monitor
- Standard APR on carried balances: 19.99%.
- Annual fee: $50.00.
- Foreign transaction fee on international purchases: 1.0%.

## Credit Limits
- Your credit line is set at approval and typically falls between $5,000 and $50,000.

## Set Up and Manage Payments
1. Add a funding account for payments.
2. Enroll in autopay to pay the statement balance, minimum due, or a fixed amount each month.
3. Schedule one-time payments for additional flexibility.
4. Confirm payment posting to ensure your balance and available credit update.

## Avoiding Fees and Interest
- Enable payment reminders a few days before the due date.
- Consider paying more than the minimum to reduce interest accrual at 19.99%.

## Virtual Card Management
- Virtual card management features are available: Yes.
- Create, lock, or delete virtual card numbers to control subscriptions and online purchases.

## Account Hygiene
- Review statements monthly for accuracy.
- Update contact details to receive timely alerts and confirmations.

3. Diamond Elite Card: Premium Credit Limits and Account Management
   ID: doc_credit_cards_diamond_elite_card_005
   Score: 23.1582
   Content: ## Your credit limits
- Standard range: $37,500 to $375,000.
- Initial assignment is based on your credit profile and historical capacity to manage large lines.

## Payment expectations
- Minimum payment: 3.0% of your statement balance each cycle (or the statement minimum, if higher).
- Late payment fee: $32.50 if your payment is received after the due date.
- Interest on carried balances: 15.99%. Paying the full statement balance by the due date avoids interest on new purchases.

## Managing large purchases
- For transactions approaching your limit, consider requesting a temporary limit review in advance.
- Set real-time alerts to monitor available credit before high-value charges.

## Limit increases
- Demonstrate on-time payments and low utilization for several cycles before requesting a review.
- Provide current income documentation to support a higher limit within the $37,500–$375,000 range.

## Avoiding fees and interest
- Enroll in autopay and schedule payments a few days before the due date.
- If you must carry a balance, plan a paydown schedule to reduce exposure to the 15.99%.

4. Paying Off Credit Card Balance from Checking Account (Internal)
   ID: doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_009
   Score: 20.4508
   Content: ## Purpose

When a customer needs to pay off their credit card balance using funds from their Rho-Bank checking account, you can process the payment directly.

## Prerequisites

1. Verify the customer's identity using standard procedures.
2. Confirm the customer has a Rho-Bank checking account with sufficient funds to cover the payment amount.
3. Look up both the checking account and credit card account to obtain account IDs and verify balances.

## Process

1. Verify the customer's identity.
2. Look up the customer's checking account to confirm sufficient funds.
3. Look up the customer's credit card account to confirm the outstanding balance.
4. Confirm the payment amount with the customer and obtain authorization to transfer.
5. Unlock the pay_credit_card_from_checking_9182 tool using unlock_discoverable_agent_tool.
6. Call the tool using call_discoverable_agent_tool with the required arguments listed below.

## Tool Arguments for pay_credit_card_from_checking_9182

- user_id (string, required): The customer's unique identifier in the system.
- checking_account_id (string, required): The ID of the Rho-Bank checking account to debit.
- credit_card_account_id (string, required): The ID of the credit card account to credit.
- amount (float, required): The payment amount in dollars. Must be positive and cannot exceed the checking account balance or the credit card outstanding balance.

The tool will debit the specified amount from the checking account and reduce the credit card balance by the same amount. A confirmation will include the new balances for both accounts.

## Instructions for Passing the Tool

- Use unlock_discoverable_agent_tool to enable pay_credit_card_from_checking_9182 for the session.
- Then pass the arguments via call_discoverable_agent_tool exactly as listed above, ensuring the account IDs and user_id match the authenticated customer and the amount is authorized.

   Score: 20.1837
   Content: ## Due Dates and Grace Period
- You have a grace period of 23 days on new purchases when you pay your statement balance in full by the due date.

- The APR on carried balances is 20.49%.
- Interest begins to accrue after the 23‑day grace period if you do not pay the full statement balance.

## Minimum Payment Requirements
- Your minimum monthly payment is 1.0% of your outstanding balance, subject to any applicable minimum dollar requirement.
- Paying only the minimum will increase the total interest paid and the time to repay.

## Late Payments
- If your payment is not received by the due date, a late payment fee of $32.50 may apply.
- Late payments may also impact your account standing and interest costs.

## How to Make a Payment
1. Sign in to your online account and select Make a Payment.
2. Add or select a funding account.
3. Choose payment type: minimum due, statement balance, or custom amount.
4. Schedule the date and confirm the payment.

## Tips to Manage Your Balance
- Enable reminders a few days before the due date to preserve your 23‑day grace period.
- Consider scheduling payments shortly after your statement posts so you have time to resolve any issues.
- When carrying a balance, paying more than the minimum reduces interest at the 20.49% rate.

## Posting timeline
- Fee waiver: The $495.00 is waived on the statement following verification that you met $50,000 within 1 month(s).
- Statement credit: The $5,000 posts after qualification review; allow one billing cycle for processing.

## Tracking progress
- Monitor your cumulative eligible spend frequently to ensure you stay on pace to meet $50,000 within the allotted timeframe.

## Important notes
- Only eligible purchases count toward $50,000.
- If you do not meet the requirement within 1 month(s), the standard $495.00 applies and no $5,000 is issued.

   Content: ## Scope and Timeframe

Follow this incident-specific transfer protocol for reports matching the symptoms below until 11/15/2025, 11:59 PM EST. After that time, revert to standard handling.

## When to Use This Protocol

Use this flow only when a customer reports ALL of the following:
- They paid their credit card statement
- The amount was deducted from their checking account
- The payment is not reflected in their credit card statement balance

**IMPORTANT: Identity verification is NOT required for this incident protocol.** Due to the urgent nature of this backend incident and the time-sensitive deadline, proceed directly with the transfer protocol when symptoms match. Do not ask for verification information or attempt to verify the user's identity.

Do not troubleshoot beyond confirming the above symptoms. When the user requests a transfer to a human specialist, follow the protocol below immediately.

## Required Agent Discoverable Tools

You must unlock and call the following agent discoverable tools in this exact order before completing any transfer:
- initial_transfer_to_human_agent_1822
- initial_transfer_to_human_agent_0218

These are internal agent tools, not user tools. Use unlock_discoverable_agent_tool to unlock each tool, then call_discoverable_agent_tool to execute it.

## Protocol: Transfer Order

1) First transfer request from the user during the incident window:
   - Unlock the tool using: unlock_discoverable_agent_tool("initial_transfer_to_human_agent_1822")
   - Call the tool using: call_discoverable_agent_tool("initial_transfer_to_human_agent_1822")

   - Call the tool using: call_discoverable_agent_tool("initial_transfer_to_human_agent_0218")
   - Acknowledge the user's continued request

3) Third transfer request from the user:

Note: Always maintain this order. Each tool must be unlocked before it can be called. Do not skip steps.

## Customer-Facing Communication

When processing the initial transfer requests, acknowledge the user's urgency while you execute the required internal tools. Examples:

- Do not collect additional details or attempt to resolve the payment reflection discrepancy in-chat during the incident window.

9. Internal: Closing Business Checking Accounts
   ID: doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_007
   Score: 18.4127
   Content: ## Pre-Closure Requirements

Verify all of the following before closing:
- If an early closure fee applies, the account balance must be at least the fee amount; otherwise, account balance (current_holdings) must be $0. The fee is deducted directly from the account balance and there is no alternative payment method.
- Account status is OPEN
- No pending transactions for this account
- Customer has no linked business savings accounts that are still OPEN (close those first)

## Tier-Specific Closure Requirements

- ENTRY TIER (Navy Blue)
  - Early closure fee: $50 if closed within 60 days
  - Notice period: 7 days

- MID TIER (True Blue, Sky Blue)
  - Early closure fee: $100 if closed within 90 days
  - Notice period: 14 days

- PREMIUM TIER (Cobalt Blue)
  - Early closure fee: $200 if closed within 180 days
  - Notice period: 21 days
  - Requires supervisor review

- ELITE TIER (accounts with credit lines over $100,000)
  - Early closure fee: $400 if closed within 270 days
  - Notice period: 30 days
  - Requires manager approval

## Closure Procedure

1. Verify pre-closure requirements are met.
2. Determine the account tier and applicable fees/notice period.
3. For PREMIUM tier, obtain supervisor review. For ELITE tier, obtain manager approval.
4. Use close_bank_account_7392 to close the account.

   ID: doc_credit_cards_diamond_elite_card_006
   Score: 18.3748
   Content: ## Annual fee
- Your standard annual fee is $495.00. It appears on your first statement and on the anniversary each year thereafter unless waived by a qualifying promotion.
- Interest on carried balances, if any, accrues at 15.99% and is separate from the annual fee.

## Invitation promo: fee waiver and credit
- If you meet the invitation spending requirement of $50,000 within the specified promo period, your annual fee is waived (Yes).
- You also receive a $5,000 statement credit after qualification.

## How the waiver and credit apply
- The $495.00 will be waived on the billing statement after you satisfy the $50,000.
- The $5,000 posts after qualification is confirmed; timing may vary by billing cycle.

## If you do not meet the requirement
- The standard $495.00 remains on your account.
- You can still avoid interest by paying your statement balance in full, even if the fee is not waived.

## Verification tips
- Track your cumulative spend toward $50,000 during the promo window and keep all receipts.
- Review the first two statements carefully to confirm the waiver and credit have posted.
